CIVIL PAYLOAD STORES
ARCHIVED SHIPPING RECORDS
YEAR 6072<New>SURVEY CARRIER THREE
Atmospheric instruments and
unmanned probe checked and
packed.<New>The probe will use its own
engines above the atmosphere.

DISPATCH: LAUNCH CREW
Received in good condition.<New>LENA / TO: ARON
Mira wants to know what the
probe will find. I said we
had to send it first. Now she
wants to watch the launch.<New>Is there room for her?

ARON / SYSTEMS
I'll save her a seat.<New>YEAR 6079 / STOCK UPDATE
Survey cradle returned from
Bank Two. Instrument
connections missing.<New>Weather package retained in
storage. No launch date
assigned.<Close>
